name: Zhong Guolong
source:
[b]"I'm the true ACGN master!"[/b]

Ethnicity: Sino-French Han Chinese with African ancestry

A dark-skinned athlete and a starting player for a semi-pro football team. His team's nickname is "Black Plum" (black on the outside, yellow on the inside).

A hardcore YUZUSOFT fan, with his goal celebration being: "Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆"

He dreams of retiring early to become an anime scapegoat writer, like Dai Dai Dai Dai Dai Dai Kawachi Ichiro.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3910860/Chinese_Black_Dragon_Legend/]Steam[/url]]
